entries.9d0454d7071c1ae5: With the motto “customer first” and “management that accurately captures the needs of the times,” its basic policy is to run a regionally rooted business through the sale of consumer goods and provision of services. Its management strategy has two pillars: “strengthening existing businesses” and “developing new businesses.” In existing businesses, it is pushing new corporate customer acquisition and enhanced sales in its main energy business; in new businesses, it is developing stores that respond to diverse consumer needs, including entry into Surugaya, Kandon and Gyomu Rentacar. It will also work on reorganizing its sales network, strengthening cost competitiveness, management focused on cash flow, and securing and developing personnel. It sets sound management and improved profitability as its management objectives, and lists indicators of capital soundness and profitability as its most important management indicators.
